title: docker volume prune reports 'Total reclaimed space: 0B' and leaves every unused named volume
symptoms: docker system prune --volumes keeps named volumes that no container uses
cause: Since Engine 23 (API 1.42) prune removes only anonymous volumes unless told to remove all. Volumes created before that upgrade cannot be classified, so the default prune never touches them.
fix: List the unused volumes first, then prune with --all when you really mean every unused volume, including named ones.
apply:
docker volume ls --filter dangling=true
docker volume prune --all
affected: Docker Engine 23.0 and later (February 2023), API version 1.42 and later
